changelog:
v2.7.1 — FORGOT PIN? EMERGENCY RESET

Adds the offline escape hatch for the App Vault.

Forgot your PIN? Tap "Forgot PIN?" → type RESET → Emergency Reset clears the PIN and the vault list and unfreezes every vault app (no app data touched). Works with zero internet — you can never be locked out of your own phone.

Second recovery path: Lyra holds a copy of your PIN in your private chat history — just ask him anytime.
